items.title: The lower shriek along a fibred category is computed by the colimit of a sheaf over the fibre categories
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter sites-cohomology.tex (Cohomology on Sites)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file sites-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma computes the lower shriek along a fibred category as the sheafification of the presheaf sending V to the colimit of F over the fibre category C_V (statement lines 9959-9970). The proof (proof lines 9972-10002) uses pullback functors along morphisms of the base to define the restriction maps through functoriality of colimits, and then verifies the defining adjunction by comparing morphism sets, using pi^{-1}G(U) = G(p(U)). H2: one construction plus one adjunction check, written out.
